blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) seized over P425 million worth of fake luxury goods in a series of operations across Metro Manila. According to the NBI, its Intellectual Property Rights Division served search warrants on separate operations conducted at Valenzuela, Manila, Taguig, and Pasay. READ: NBI confiscates P120M worth of fake luxury goods Seized during operations were 1,608 assorted products, 10 boxes of bags and 3 boxes of eyewear bearing the Louis Vuitton name. The NBI said the projected market value of seized goods had a total of P425,255,115. /mr... Keep on reading: NBI: Over P425M in fake luxury goods seized in Metro Manila
